completed_tasks.description: Project scaffolding: pyproject.toml (uv), Typer CLI entrypoint, src/envcheck/ package structure
.envcheck.yaml schema design + config loader with Pydantic validation
.env file scanner — parse .env, .env.*, .env.example files, extract key-value pairs
Docker config scanner — extract env blocks from docker-compose.yml and Dockerfile (ARG/ENV)
CI config scanner — parse GitHub Actions workflow YAML for env: blocks and secrets references
Basic environment profile builder — aggregate scanner results into EnvironmentProfile model
Var diff engine — compare env vars across profiles: missing, extra, value-changed, type-changed
Service version diff — detect version mismatches in Docker images (e.g. postgres:16 vs postgres:15)
Rich terminal reporter — color-coded table (green=ok, yellow=diff, red=missing, gray=extra)
JSON output mode — --json flag for CI/machine consumption
Exit codes — 0 = clean, 1 = drift detected, 2 = error; with --strict mode for CI
